extra.final_summary: Found and fixed several data issues affecting the order count by category. One exact duplicate row was removed. Category and Region labels were normalized to correct case and spelling variants. Two rows with negative Quantity (violating the rule that Quantity >= 1) were excluded. One row had Revenue corrected to match Quantity * Price. After these fixes, the analysis shows: Accessories: 20 orders, Electronics: 13 orders, Furniture: 11 orders, Office Supplies: 11 orders.
